column1: # OpenHaldex S3 Dash - 4 MB flash layout
# Two equal app slots so the dash can be updated over the air once it is
# installed in the car (there is no USB cable behind the dashboard).
# The factory firmware on this board used a single 3.75 MB app slot plus a
# 128 KB spiffs. This table keeps a 128 KB LittleFS (unused for now) and
# splits the rest into two 1.875 MB OTA slots - enough for the ~1.53 MB
# LVGL + WiFi image with room for growth.
